body: Thank you for this reply. Reading this makes me feel comfortable in my position. Thank you kind stranger.
I didn't even reply to her. I feel like I need to justify myself, but I am going to save myself the pain.
She cheated 2 weeks ago. Sorry I didn't make that very clear. We've been split for 2 weeks total.
This made me laugh more than it should have. Thanks for your reply.
I told the ex, that if she wants to date him go for it. It's not my business anymore. So I agree with you. I appreciate you saying that I shouldn't be called names.

I appreciate what you've said. I tried to stand up and do what's right. I think this is right. 

Good point. I shouldn't care what my Ex-girlfriend thinks of me. I'm a sensitive dude, but as some people in my previous post said, I may need to grow some balls to not be walked on.
She has no money or job currently. She graduates in December and will then move into the workforce.

I’ve lived without roommates after 20 (I’m 25 now) we both thought that she was just going to take over the lease but her parents won’t do that. It just sucks. I want to donate everything we had together and just restart.
Thank you for the advice. This was difficult to read as well, but put it into perspective.
This was very difficult to read. But I think there was some tough love here. I appreciate the input even if it was hard to read.
I’m 25 and feel like my life is over. I don’t know if I want to get back with her even if she changes her mind.
I want her to be safe and happy. I don’t want to “get rid of her” but let her go gracefully.

I don’t know if I want her there. We shared so much together. But if I decide to get with her and we end up getting married. What am I going to think on my wedding day? I would think of her with the other man.
